component.name: Pigeon Mail
component.summary: Read and send email on GNOME

description.p: Pigeon Mail is a GNOME email client using GNOME Online Accounts and Evolution Data Server for accounts, offline mail storage, and delivery.
It supports HTML mail, sending identities, attachments, drafts, search, and cache-first message actions.
Keep cached message switching responsive during downloads and document the Microsoft 365 alias transport fix.
Improve account refresh and recovery, composition state handling, and asynchronous attachment saving.
Notify from every mail folder, open the real source folder, and improve cached mailbox consistency.
Fix desktop Compose activation, mailto URI handling, and stub composition.
